description: This source file defines the BitVector32Codec class, which is a serializer for the BitVector32 type in the Orleans.Serialization framework. It implements methods to write and read BitVector32 values to and from a serialized form, integrating with the Orleans serialization infrastructure.

classes.name: BitVector32Codec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for BitVector32, providing serialization and deserialization logic for BitVector32 instances.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a BitVector32 value to the specified writer, writing a field header and the integer data of the BitVector32.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a BitVector32 value from the specified reader, reading an integer and constructing a BitVector32 instance.
